summary: Exhaustive validation of the NEW zero-loading Conseil (admin) journey on desktop 1440 + mobile 390. ALL critical acceptance criteria met: visitor → CONSEIL renders login form in 299ms with NO 'OUVERTURE DU COFFRE' loader and NO admin-session-checking testid in DOM (sampled every 25ms over 800ms); authed return → CONSEIL renders dashboard in 174ms with NO loader and NO login-form flash; hash deep link #messagerie works; logout removes gp-auth-ok flag and nav button returns to crimson (bg rgba(139,0,0,0.25)); expiry safety path (cookies cleared + flag forced) silently falls back to login form, flag removed, no crash; FR/EN translation complete on login page ('THE COUNCIL'S CHEST', 'CAPTAIN'S COURIER', 'CHEST SECRET', 'OPEN THE CHEST' in EN); zero 'a.loading' key leaks; mobile 390 renders form without overflow (scrollW==clientW==390).
critical_code_review_comments: Admin.jsx is large; consider extracting LoginScreen into its own file for maintainability (minor, no functional impact).
seed_data_creation: None. Cleaned sessionStorage + localStorage + cookies at end of test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Conseil nav testid is 'nav-link-council' (not 'nav-admin-btn'). Hero 'suivre ma candidature' button has a different testid than 'nav-cta-suivi' (nav-cta-suivi may only render in drawer at some widths). Zero-loading strategy fully validated: gp-auth-ok sessionStorage flag → optimistic dashboard, silent /auth/me confirmation on background; failure path drops to login form within <2s without loader. Benign 401 console noise during logged-out /auth/me calls — ignore.
notes: The suivi hero button test used selector 'nav-cta-suivi' which times out at 1440 width because that CTA is in the drawer; the hero 'SUIVRE MA CANDIDATURE' button on home (visible in screenshot) was NOT exercised in this run, but was already validated green in iteration_23 and user confirmed it works. The /donations ('butin') nav took 102ms confirming other buttons remain instant. Expiry-fallback timing shows negative value due to performance.now() crossing page navigation — the functional outcome (login form appeared, flag cleared) is what matters and both are correct.
